name: David Rheaume
caption: Lost Re-RAW's opening tag match by chair-blasting his own partner mid-match, then was superpowerbombed through a table three weeks later teaming with MAZHAT.

name: Brett Read
caption: Tapped out in Re-RAW's opening match, then won his following appearance teaming with debuting newcomer Justin Harper.

tenures.note: Named once, in this same opening match's own text, as "Brett Paul" before the broadcast settles on "Brett Read" for the rest of the held record; read as one wrestler, not two.

name: Charles Paul
caption: Lost Re-RAW's opening tag match, then lost again three weeks later teaming with newcomer Curt Lawson.

tenures.note: Named once, in this same opening match's own text, as "Charles Read" before the broadcast settles on "Charles Paul" for the rest of the held record; read as one wrestler, not two.

name: Lucifer Magnusson
caption: Debuted as Werewolf Gregorson's secret partner, pinning Arron Iron, and later formed the villainous duo Hostile Takeover with Gregorson.

tenures.note: Introduced on screen as a figure who "helped shut down" two other federations, Rumble Pro Wrestling and Kick Ass Wrestling Federation, as part of a group called Hatebreed; those closures are the debuting wrestler's own on-screen backstory, not independently attested by the held record.

name: Orin LeBlanc
caption: Attacked Jay Ruby backstage to force his way into Re-RAW's first main event, then went on to make the promotion's own top four in its fan-voted championship tournament.

name: Justin Harper
caption: Debuted alongside Brett Read in a tag win, billed as a former RAW Carolina tag champion.

name: Curt Lawson
caption: Debuted in a tag loss alongside Charles Paul, against Justin Harper and Brett Read.

name: Cardinal Synn
caption: Lucifer Magnusson's manager, who leads him to the ring on a leash and calls his attacks.

name: Andrew Krumm
caption: Lost his only Re-RAW appearance, teaming with Jack Polanski against El Savaje and Black Creek Bart.

identity.note: A different, already-tenured wrestler of the same name is on record at a 2000 federation with no roster, host, or date overlap with this one; nothing links the two.

name: Jack Polanski
caption: Wrestled as "Genocide" Jack Ripper before Re-RAW, where he lost his only appearance teaming with Andrew Krumm; placed #116 in the 2004 RSPWF Top 200 under the older name.

tenures.note: Billed on commentary as a former wrestler known as "Jack Ripper."
Billed "'Genocide' Jack Ripper," wrestling as Thunder Valenkov's own 'dream partner.'

name: Black Creek Bart
caption: Debuted teaming with El Savaje in a win over Andrew Krumm and Jack Polanski.

name: F-Dot
caption: Half of the tag team Drunken Phone Call with Ryab; lost to Ricky Hussein and Drew Piper by chair interference, then was powerbombed through a glass table alongside his own partner three weeks later.

name: Ryab
caption: Half of the tag team Drunken Phone Call with F-Dot; lost to Ricky Hussein and Drew Piper by chair interference, then was powerbombed through a glass table alongside his own partner three weeks later.

name: Drew Piper
caption: Won Re-RAW's opening broadcast's third match by chair interference, later paid a newcomer to injure his own tag partner, and made the promotion's own top four in its fan-voted championship tournament.

name: Ricky Hussein
caption: Won Re-RAW's opening broadcast's third match teaming with Drew Piper, and was later hospitalized with a broken leg and a punctured lung after Piper paid a newcomer to attack him.

tenures.note: Billed on commentary as a former face of RAW UK.

name: MAZHAT
caption: David Rheaume's tag partner and companion, superpowerbombed through a table alongside him.

name: "Joltin'" Joe Mauler
caption: Debuted teaming with Lark Fenriz in a win over David Rheaume and MAZHAT, an uneasy partnership Mauler himself openly resented before the bell.

name: Terrell "Bishop" Griffin
caption: A newcomer paid by Drew Piper to attack Piper's own tag partner Ricky Hussein backstage, hospitalizing him.

name: Jay Ruby
caption: An academy wrestler brutally attacked backstage by Orin LeBlanc to remove him from Re-RAW's first main event.

name: Rebel Yell
caption: Re-RAW's owner, who reopened the promotion on its first broadcast and books its shows from a private box.

name: Sean O'Brien
caption: Re-RAW's lead play-by-play commentator.

name: Ebony Andrews
caption: Re-RAW's backstage interviewer.

name: Casey Cool
caption: A Re-RAW reporter sent to interview Werewolf Gregorson at his home, and rebuked for arriving a day late.

name: Cassidy
caption: Werewolf Gregorson's personal assistant.

name: Leah Maynard-McCray
caption: Doug McCray's ring valet and wife, who stitches his wounds between broadcasts and needles him about his in-ring decisions.

name: Arron Iron
notes: Known only from the RSPWF Top 200, the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll. Placings and the poll's own federation tags, verbatim — 2004: #30, tagged WILD. caption: Lost Re-RAW's second-ever match teaming with Ric Beauty, then returned three weeks later as one half of the self-named team Sexual Assault.

tenures.note: Billed 'Aaron Iron' on both VXW broadcasts (a spelling variant of the held name).
